WITH filtered AS (
  SELECT 
    a.translink,
    t.ordertypedist,
    COUNT(*) as combo_count
  FROM advancedbehavior a
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON a.translink = t.transreg
  WHERE a.peercorr >= 0.149
    AND t.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.translink, t.ordertypedist
),
totals AS (
  SELECT 
    ordertypedist,
    SUM(combo_count) as type_total
  FROM filtered
  GROUP BY ordertypedist
)
SELECT 
  f.translink,
  f.ordertypedist,
  f.combo_count,
  CAST(f.combo_count AS REAL) / t.type_total as fraction
FROM filtered f
JOIN totals t ON f.ordertypedist = t.ordertypedist
ORDER BY fraction DESC, f.translink
LIMIT 10
